CREATE  function [dbo].[cxcCreditoporDist](@idCliente int, @Fecha datetime)
returns decimal(19,2)
as
begin

declare @bal decimal(19,2)

select 
  @Bal = (sum(Valor) - (sum(Aplicado / Tasa)))
from (
SELECT     
  c.Valor,
  c.Tasa, 
  SUM(isnull(cd.Valor * cd.Tasa,0.00)) AS Aplicado
FROM         
  dbo.Cxc c left JOIN
  dbo.CxcDet cd ON c.idCxc = cd.idCxc
WHERE     
  (c.esCredito = 1)
  and (c.fecha <= @Fecha)
  and (c.idCliente = @idCliente)
  and (c.Cancelado = 0)
  and ((cd.fecha is null) or (cd.fecha <= @Fecha))
GROUP BY 
  c.idCliente, 
  c.idCxc,
  c.Valor,
  c.Tasa) Datos


 return isnull(@bal,0.00)
end

         c.cxc,
         sum(d.TotalAplicado) as Valor
  from cxc c join recibo r
    on c.idcxc = r.idRecibo
    join reciboTipo t on r.idReciboTipo = t.idReciboTipo
    join cxcdet d on c.idcxc = d.idCxc
  where t.esAvance = 1
        and d.Fecha between @desde and @hasta
  group by t.cc, t.CtaAplicacion, c.CXC

  insert into @ctas (idCuenta, Descripcion, Valor, DebCre, Fecha, Referencia)
  select CtaCredito as idCuenta,
         '' as Descripcion,
         Valor,
         2 as DebCre,
         @hasta,
         Referencia
  from @apps
  where isnull(Valor,0.00) > 0
  union
  select CtaDebito as idCuenta,
         '' as Descripcion,
         Valor,
         2 as DebCre,
         @hasta,
         Referencia
  from @apps
  where isnull(Valor,0.00) > 0

 return 
end

CREATE  function [dbo].[cxcPorcientoAbonoDoc] (@idFactura uniqueidentifier, @Desde datetime, @Hasta datetime)
returns decimal(19,2)
as
begin
  declare 
  @resultado decimal(19,2) ,
  @Credito bit,
  @Total numeric(19,2),
  @Pagado numeric(19,2)
  
  Select 
   @Credito = f.credito, 
   @Total = f.Total
  From 
    factura f
  Where
    f.idFactura = @idFactura

  IF @Credito = 0 
  begin
     Set @Resultado = 1
  end
  ELSE
  begin

    Set @Pagado = isnull((
      select 
          sum(d.Valor)
      from
        cxcDet d
      where 
        d.idCXCDebito = @idFactura
        and d.fecha between @Desde and @Hasta),0)

     Set @Resultado = @Pagado / @Total

  end
  return isnull(@resultado, 0.00)
end

functions.definition:
CREATE function [dbo].[cxcResumenAging]  
 (@final datetime)  
returns @ret table (  
NoVenc decimal(19,2),   
A15 decimal(19,2),   
A30 decimal(19,2),   
A45 decimal(19,2),   
A60 decimal(19,2),  
AMas60 decimal(19,2))  
as  
begin  
   
 declare @aging table (idcxc uniqueidentifier,  
        Dias int,  
        Fecha datetime,  
        Vencimiento datetime,  
        Total decimal(19,2),  
        pagado decimal(19,2))  
  
insert into @aging     
  select           
    t.idCXC,       
    Dias = datediff(day, t.fecha + 30, @final),       
    t.Fecha,     
    t.Fecha + 30,     
    t.Valor as Total,      
    Pagado = (isnull(      
   (select sum(d.TotalAplicado)      
          from       
              cxc c       
              join cxcDet d on c.idCXC = d.idCXC      
          where       
              d.fecha <= @final      
     and c.cancelado = 0    
              and d.idCXCDebito = t.idCXC      
          ),0))   
  from       
    CXC t join factura f on t.idcxc = f.idfactura       
  where       
    t.EsCredito = 0      
    and  t.fecha <=  @final  
    and t.cancelado = 0      
    and t.valor > isnull(      
   (select sum(d.TotalAplicado)      
          from       
              cxc c       
              join cxcDet d on c.idCXC = d.idCXC      
          where       
              d.fecha <= @final      
     and c.cancelado = 0    
              and d.idCXCDebito = t.idCXC      
          ),0)  
      
      
    insert into @ret   
    select sum(NoVenc) as NoVenc,  
     sum(A15) as A15,  
     sum(A30) as A30,  
     sum(A45) as A45,  
     sum(A60) as A60,  
     sum(AMas60) as AMas60  
 from (  
    select t.*,  
    NoVenc = case when dias <= 0 then Total - Pagado else $0 end,      
    A15    = case when dias between 01 and 15 then Total - Pagado else $0 end,      
    A30    = case when dias between 16 and 30 then Total - Pagado else $0 end,      
    A45    = case when dias between 31 and 45 then Total - Pagado else $0 end,      
    A60    = case when dias between 46 and 60 then Total - Pagado else $0 end,      
    AMas60 = case when dias between 61 and 120 then Total - Pagado else $0 end  
    from @aging t    
    ) as data   
      
return  
end

create function [dbo].[cxcTotalCreditosNoAplicados]
 (@final datetime)  
returns decimal(19,2)  
as  
begin  
  
declare @balanceFinal decimal(19,2)  
  
declare @tmpcxc table (  
 idcxc uniqueidentifier,  
 idMoneda int,  
 Valor decimal(19,2),  
 Tasa float,  
 Pagado decimal(19,2)  
)  
  
--insert into @tmpcxc  
-- (idcxc, idmoneda, valor, tasa, pagado)   
--  select       
-- t.idcxc,    
--    t.idMoneda,          
--    t.Valor as Total,      
-- t.Tasa,   
--    Pagado = (isnull(      
--   (select sum(d.TotalAplicado)      
--          from       
--              cxc c       
--              join cxcDet d on c.idCXC = d.idCXC      
--          where       
--              d.fecha <= @final      
--     and c.cancelado = 0    
--              and d.idCXCDebito = t.idCXC      
--          ),0))  
--  from       
--    CXC t           
--  where       
--    t.EsCredito = 0      
--    and  t.fecha <=  @final  
--    and t.cancelado = 0      
  
insert into @tmpcxc  
 (idcxc, idmoneda, valor, tasa, pagado)   
  select    
 t.idcxc,    
    t.idMoneda,          
    (t.Valor - isnull(sum((d.Valor*d.tasa)/t.tasa),0.00)) as Total,      
 t.Tasa,  
    Pagado = 0.00  
  from       
    cxc t       
    left join cxcDet d on t.idCXC = d.idCXC and d.fecha <= @final           
  where       
    t.EsCredito = 1      
    and t.fecha <= @final        
    and t.cancelado = 0      
  group by           
 t.idcxc,   
    t.idMoneda,      
 t.Valor,   
    t.Tasa  
  having t.Valor <> isnull(sum((d.Valor*d.tasa)/t.tasa),0.00)    
------      
  
select @BalanceFinal = sum((Valor) * case when isnull(tasa,0) = 0 then 1 else tasa end)   
from @tmpcxc  
  
return isnull(@balanceFinal,0.00)  
  
end

create function [dbo].[cxpBalanceCXPAging]
 (@final datetime)
returns decimal(19,2)
as
begin

declare @balanceFinal decimal(19,2)

declare @MonLegal int

select top 1 @MonLegal = idMoneda
from moneda 
where CursoLegal = 1 

declare @tmpcxp table (
 idcxp uniqueidentifier,
 idMoneda int,
 Valor decimal(19,2),
 Tasa float,
 Pagado decimal(19,2)
)

insert into @tmpcxp
 (idcxp, idmoneda, valor, tasa, pagado) 
  select     
	t.Guiddocumento,  
    t.idMoneda,        
    t.Total,    
	t.Tasa, 
    Pagado = isnull((select sum(d.Valor) from cxpDocumentosDtl d
			   join cxpDocumentos s on d.idDocumento = s.idDocumento
			   where d.idDocXPagar = t.idDocumento 
				 and (s.Status <> 'C' or (s.status = 'C' and isnull(s.FechaStatus,s.fecha) > @final))
                                 and d.fecha <= @final
				 and s.MostrarEnCXP = 1),0.00)
--    Pagado = (isnull(    
--   (select sum(d.Valor)    
--          from     
--              cxpDocumentos c     
--              join cxpDocumentosDtl d on c.idDocumento = d.idDocumento
--          where     
--              d.fecha <= @final    
--			  and c.status <> 'C'
--              and d.idDocXPagar = t.idDocumento
--          ),0))
  from     
    cxpDocumentos t join TiposTrans tt on t.idTrans = tt.idTrans and tt.Sistema = 'CXP'
  where     
    tt.DebCre = 2
	and t.MostrarEnCXP = 1
    and  t.fecha <=  @final
    and t.status <> 'C'

insert into @tmpcxp
 (idcxp, idmoneda, valor, tasa, pagado) 
  select  
	t.GuidDocumento,  
    t.idMoneda,        
    -(t.Total - isnull(sum((d.Valor*d.tasa)/ case when t.idMoneda = @MonLegal then 1 else t.tasa end),0.00)) as Total,    
	t.Tasa,
    Pagado = 0.00
  from     
    cxpDocumentos t join TiposTrans tt on t.idTrans = tt.idTrans and tt.Sistema = 'CXP'
    left join cxpDocumentosDtl d on t.idDocumento = d.idDocumento and d.fecha <= @final         
  where     
    tt.DebCre = 1    
	and t.MostrarEnCXP = 1
    and t.fecha <= @final      
    and t.Status <> 'C'
  group by         
	t.GuidDocumento, 
    t.idMoneda,    
	t.Total, 
    t.Tasa
  having t.Total <> isnull(sum((d.Valor*d.tasa)/ case when t.idMoneda = @MonLegal then 1 else t.tasa end),0.00)  
------    

select @BalanceFinal = sum((Valor - Pagado) * case idMoneda when @MonLegal then 1 else Tasa end) 
from @tmpcxp

return isnull(@balanceFinal,0.00)

end

CREATE FUNCTION padStringLeft
    (
      @str VARCHAR(1000) ,
      @len INT ,
      @ch CHAR(1)
    )
RETURNS VARCHAR(1000)
AS
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @ret VARCHAR(1000)
  
        IF LEN(@str) >= @len
            SET @ret = LEFT(@str, @len)
        ELSE
            BEGIN
                SET @ret = REPLICATE(@ch, @len - LEN(ISNULL(@str, '')))
                    + ISNULL(@str, '')
            END
        RETURN @ret
    END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[cxpCodificarPagoDocs](@idSolicitud int)
RETURNS @ctas TABLE 
(
    -- columns returned by the function
    idCuenta varchar(16) NOT NULL,
    Debito decimal(19,2) NOT NULL,
    Credito decimal(19,2) NOT NULL
)
AS
-- body of the function
BEGIN
  
   declare @docs table (
     idDocumento int, idMoneda int, Tasa float,
	 Total decimal(19,2), Pagado decimal(19,2), idCuenta varchar(16))	
	 
	insert into @docs
	select  d.idDocumento,	    
			d.idMoneda,
			sd.Tasa,		
			d.Total,
			sd.Valor as Pagado, 
			d.idCuenta
	from cxpSolicitudes s join cxpSolicitudesDtl sd on s.idSolicitud = sd.idSolicitud
	join cxpDocumentos d on sd.idDocumento = d.idDocumento -- left join costCostoDocumento co  on d.Guiddocumento = co.idDocumento
	where s.idSolicitud = @idSolicitud 

	insert into @ctas (idCuenta, Debito, Credito)
	select idCuenta,
		   Pagado,
		   0.00
	from @docs
	union all
	select p.idCuentaPrima,
		   Pagado * (Tasa - 1.00),
		   0.00
	from @docs d join cgCuentaPrima p on d.idCuenta = p.idCuenta
	where d.idMoneda <> 1 

   RETURN
END

create function [dbo].[cxpForzarMoneda]
 (@valor decimal, @tasaDet float, @tasaHdr float, @fec datetime, @idMon int, @idMonHdr int)
returns decimal(19,2)
as 
begin
  declare @ret decimal(19,2), @tasa float 
  if @idMon = @idMonHdr
    set @ret = (@valor * @tasaDet) / @tasaHdr
  else begin
    if @idMon = 1 
      set @ret = (@valor * @tasaDet)
    else begin
      if @tasaDet <= 1 begin
        set @tasa = dbo.fTasaActual(@idMon, @fec)
        set @ret = @Valor / @tasa 
      end
      else 
        set @ret = @Valor 
    end      
  end   
  return @ret
end

  left join cxpDocumentosDtl d on h.idDocumento = d.idDocumento and d.Fecha <= @final   
where 	h.MostrarEnCXP = 1 	
	and h.Fecha <= @final
	and tt.debcre = 1
	and (isnull(h.Status,'A') <> 'C' or (isnull(h.Status,'A') = 'C' and isnull(h.FechaStatus,h.fecha) > @final))
group by h.idDocumento, h.Total, h.Tasa 
having h.Total * h.Tasa <> isnull(sum(d.valor * d.Tasa),0)

select @res = sum(valor) - isnull(sum(aplicado),0.00)
from @docs
return isnull(@res,0.00)
end

CREATE function [dbo].[cxpTotalCXPAging]  
 (@final datetime, @Vencido bit)  
returns decimal(19,2)  
as  
begin  
  
declare @balanceFinal decimal(19,2)  
  
declare @MonLegal int  
  
select top 1 @MonLegal = idMoneda  
from moneda   
where CursoLegal = 1   
  
declare @tmpcxp table (  
 idcxp uniqueidentifier,  
 idMoneda int,  
 Valor decimal(19,2),  
 Tasa float,  
 Pagado decimal(19,2)  
)  
  
insert into @tmpcxp  
 (idcxp, idmoneda, valor, tasa, pagado)   
  select       
 t.Guiddocumento,    
    t.idMoneda,          
    t.Total,      
 t.Tasa,   
    Pagado = isnull((select sum(d.Valor) from cxpDocumentosDtl d  
      join cxpDocumentos s on d.idDocumento = s.idDocumento  
      where d.idDocXPagar = t.idDocumento   
     and (s.Status <> 'C' or (s.status = 'C' and isnull(s.FechaStatus,s.fecha) > @final))  
                                 and d.fecha <= @final  
     and s.MostrarEnCXP = 1),0.00)  
--    Pagado = (isnull(      
--   (select sum(d.Valor)      
--          from       
--              cxpDocumentos c       
--              join cxpDocumentosDtl d on c.idDocumento = d.idDocumento  
--          where       
--              d.fecha <= @final      
--     and c.status <> 'C'  
--              and d.idDocXPagar = t.idDocumento  
--          ),0))  
  from       
    cxpDocumentos t join TiposTrans tt on t.idTrans = tt.idTrans and tt.Sistema = 'CXP'  
  where       
    tt.DebCre = 2  
 and t.MostrarEnCXP = 1  
    and  case @Vencido

CREATE function [dbo].[cxpTotalItbisDoc]
(@idDoc int)
returns decimal(19,2)
as
begin
  declare @tblctas table (idCuenta varchar(16))
  declare @factor int 
  set @factor = 1 
  if exists (select t.debcre from cxpdocumentos d join TiposTrans t
			  on d.idtrans = t.idtrans and t.sistema = 'CXP'
			where d.idDocumento = @idDoc and t.debcre = 1)
    set @factor = -1
  declare @tasa float
  select @tasa = tasa 
  from cxpdocumentos where iddocumento = @idDoc
  insert into @tblCtas
  select distinct idCuenta
  from ocTiposImpuestos
  where itbis = 1 and Activo = 1 
  if isnull(@tasa,1) > 1
    insert into @tblCtas
    select distinct p.idCuentaPrima
    from ocTiposImpuestos i join cgCuentaPrima p 
    on i.idCuenta = p.idCuenta
    where i.itbis = 1 and i.Activo = 1 
		  and not exists (select 1 from @tblCtas where idCuenta = p.idCuentaPrima)
  declare @res decimal(19,2)
  select @res = sum((CASE when DebCre = 1 then Valor else -valor end)) 
  from cxpDocCuentas c join @tblCtas i on c.idCuenta = i.idCuenta 
	where c.idDocumento = @idDoc	     
--	      and DebCre = 1  verificar esto
return isnull(@res * @factor,0.00)
end

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fHorario] (@Empleado Int, @Fecha DateTime) 
RETURNs Float 
AS
BEGIN  
  Return(
SELECT
  Top 1
  CASE
    When DatePart(weekday, @Fecha) = 1 Then
      Convert(Float,IsNull(SunEnd,0.0)) - Convert(Float,IsNull(SunStart,0.0))
    When DatePart(weekday, @Fecha) = 2 Then
      Convert(Float, IsNull(MonEnd,0.0)) - Convert(Float, IsNull(MonStart,0.0))
    When DatePart(weekday, @Fecha) = 3 Then
      Convert(Float, IsNull(TueEnd, 0.0)) - Convert(Float, IsNull(TueStart,0.0))
    When DatePart(weekday, @Fecha) = 4 Then
      Convert(Float, IsNull(WedEnd, 0.0))  - Convert(Float, IsNull(WedStart,0.0))
    When DatePart(weekday, @Fecha) = 5 Then
      Convert(Float, IsNull(ThuEnd, 0.0)) - Convert(Float, IsNull(ThuStart,0.0))
    When DatePart(weekday, @Fecha) = 6 Then
      Convert(Float, IsNull(FriEnd, 0.0)) - Convert(Float, IsNull(FriStart,0.0))
    When DatePart(weekday, @Fecha) = 7 Then
      Convert(Float, IsNull(SatEnd, 0.0)) - Convert(Float, IsNull(SatStart,0.0))
  END Horario
FROM
  FromReloj
WHERE
  Number = @Empleado)
END

CREATE  FUNCTION [dbo].[fHorasDoble](@Fecha DateTime, @Empleado Int)  
RETURNS float AS  
BEGIN
  Declare 
    @NT float,
    @Entrada DateTime, @Salida DateTime,
    @Horas float,
    @Time DateTime, @Estado Bit

--si trabaja o no ese dia debe salir en el mismo query
  Set
    @NT = dbo.fHorario(@Empleado, @Fecha)

  Set @Horas = 0
    
   DECLARE cPonches Cursor For
   Select
     Time1
   From
     FromReloj
   Where
     Number = @Empleado And
     ReportingDate = @Fecha And
     ((HolyDay = 1)  OR  (@NT = 0))

   Open cPonches
   Set @Estado = 1
   Set @Horas = 0 

   While (@@Fetch_Status = 0) Or (@Estado = 1)
   Begin
     Set @Estado = 0

     Fetch Next From cPonches Into @Time
     Set @Entrada = @Time
     Fetch Next From cPonches Into @Time
     Set @Salida  = @Time 
 
     IF (@@Fetch_Status = 0)
     BEGIN
       Set @Horas = @Horas + CONVERT(FLOAT,(@Salida - @Entrada))
     END
   End

  Return Round(IsNull(@Horas,0.0) ,2)
END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fHorasNocturnas](@Fecha DateTime, @Empleado Int)  
RETURNS float AS  
BEGIN
  Declare   
    @Entrada DateTime, @Salida DateTime,
    @Horas float,
    @Minuto float, 
    @Inicio DateTime,@Ini DateTime,@Desde DateTime,@Hasta DateTime, @tmp int,
    @Time DateTime, @Estado Bit, @tmpx int, @tmpY Int
-- Seleccionar True o False si esta fecha es HolyDay

    
  DECLARE cPonches Cursor For
  Select
    Time1
  From
    FromReloj
  Where
    Number = @Empleado And
    ReportingDate = @Fecha and
    HolyDay = 0

  Open cPonches
  Set @Estado = 1
  Set @Horas = 0.00

  While (@@Fetch_Status = 0) Or (@Estado = 1)
  Begin
    Set @Estado = 0

    Fetch Next From cPonches Into @Time
    Set @Entrada = @Time
    Fetch Next From cPonches Into @Time
    Set @Salida  = @Time

    IF (@@Fetch_Status = 0)
    BEGIN
     Set @Minuto = 0

     Set @Inicio = @Entrada
-- - Convert(Int, @Entrada)
     Set @tmp = round(Convert(float,@Inicio),0,1)
     Set @Desde = Convert(DateTime,'21:00:00')
     Set @Hasta = Convert(DateTime, '07:01:00') + 1

     While (@Inicio <= @Salida)
     Begin
--       Set @tmp = round(Convert(float,@Inicio),0,1)
       Set @Ini = (@Inicio - @tmp) + @tmpx
       If @Ini Between @Desde And @Hasta
       Begin
         Set @Minuto = @Minuto + 1
       End
       Set @Tmpx = 0
       Set @tmpY = round(Convert(float,@Inicio),0,1)  
       Set @Inicio = DateAdd(mi, 1, @Inicio)
       Set @tmpX = round(Convert(float,@Inicio),0,1)- @tmpY
     End
     Set @Horas = @Horas + (@Minuto / 60)
     END
  End

  Return round(@Horas ,2)
END

CREATE  FUNCTION [dbo].[fHorasNormales](@Fecha DateTime, @Empleado Int)  
RETURNS float AS  
BEGIN
  Declare 
    @Entrada DateTime, 
    @Salida DateTime,
    @Horas float,
    @Minuto float, 
    @Inicio DateTime,@Ini DateTime,@Desde DateTime,@Hasta DateTime, @tmp int,
    @Time DateTime, @Estado Bit

-- Seleccionar True o False si esta fecha es HolyDay
    
  DECLARE cPonches Cursor For
  Select
    Time1
  From
    FromReloj
  Where
    Number = @Empleado And
    ReportingDate = @Fecha and
    HolyDay = 0

  Open cPonches
  Set @Estado = 1
  Set @Horas = 0

  While (@@Fetch_Status = 0) Or (@Estado = 1)
  Begin
    Set @Estado = 0

    Fetch Next From cPonches Into @Time
    Set @Entrada = @Time
    Fetch Next From cPonches Into @Time
    Set @Salida  = @Time

    IF (@@Fetch_Status = 0)
    BEGIN
     Set @Minuto = 0
     Set @Inicio = @Entrada
     Set @Desde = Convert(DateTime,'07:00:00')
     Set @Hasta = Convert(DateTime, '21:00:00')
     Set @tmp = round(Convert(float,@Inicio),0,1)

     While (@Inicio <= @Salida)
     Begin
        Set @Ini = (@Inicio - @tmp)
        If @Ini Between @Desde And @Hasta
        Begin
          Set @Minuto = @Minuto + 1
        End
        Set @Inicio = DateAdd(mi, 1, @Inicio)
     End
     Set @Horas = @Horas + (@Minuto / 60)
    END
  End

  Return Round(@Horas ,2)
END

functions.name: fHorasNormales1
functions.definition:
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fHorasNormales1](@Fecha DateTime, @Empleado Int)  
RETURNS Money AS  
BEGIN
  Declare 
    @Dia SmallInt,
    @Entrada DateTime, @Salida DateTime, 
    @HorarioIn DateTime, @HorarioOut DateTime,
    @Horas Int

  Set
    @Dia = (Select 
             DatePart(weekday, @Fecha))
  Select
    Top 1
    @HorarioIn  = Entrada,
    @HorarioOut = Salida
  From
    dbo.fHorario(@Empleado, @Fecha)
    
    
    If (@Dia <> 1) And ((Not @HorarioIn = 0) Or (Not @HorarioOut = 0))
    Begin
      Set 
        @Entrada = (Select
                      Top 1 
                      Time1 
                    From 
                      FromReloj 
                    Where 
                      ReportingDate = @Fecha And 
                      Number = @Empleado And 
                      InOrOut = 'IN' And 
                      HolyDay = 0)
      Set
        @Salida  = (Select 
                      Top 1
                      Time1 
                    From 
                      FromReloj 
                    Where 
                      ReportingDate = @Fecha And 
                      Number = @Empleado And 
                      InOrOut = 'OUT' And 
                      HolyDay = 0)
                             
                    
      If @Salida > (@HorarioOut + Convert(Int, @Salida))
      Begin
        Set
          @Horas = DateDiff(hh, (@HorarioOut + Convert(Int, @Salida, 102)),@Entrada)
      End
      Else
      Begin
        Set
          @Horas = DateDiff(hh, @Salida, @Entrada)
      End
    End
    Else
    Begin
      Set
        @Horas = 0
    End

  Return @Horas 
END

BEGIN

		FROM         VacacionTabla
		WHERE     (@Meses BETWEEN Desde AND Hasta))
END
return @Dias
END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[GetProductoDet] 
	(@idProducto varchar(25), @Cantidad float)
RETURNS @tblprods TABLE 
	(idProducto varchar(25), Referencia varchar(25), Cantidad float )
AS
BEGIN
  declare c cursor local for
  select pd.idProductoDet, pd.Cantidad * @Cantidad
  from productodet pd join producto p
    on pd.idProductodet = p.idProducto
  where pd.idProducto = @idProducto
	and p.Compuesto = 1

  declare @idProd varchar(25), @Cant float

  insert into @tblprods (idProducto, Cantidad, Referencia)
  select pd.idProductoDet, pd.Cantidad * @Cantidad, @idProducto
  from productodet pd join producto p
    on pd.idProductodet = p.idProducto
  where pd.idProducto = @idProducto
	and p.Compuesto = 0
  
  open c
  fetch next from c into @idProd, @Cant
  while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 
  begin
    
    insert into @tblprods (idProducto, Cantidad, Referencia)
    select idProducto, Cantidad, Referencia
       from dbo.GetProductoDet(@idProd, @Cant)
  
    fetch next from c into @idProd, @Cant
  end

  close c
  deallocate c

 return 
end

CREATE Function [dbo].[HowManyMonth](@FechaInicial DateTime, @FechaFinal DateTime)
Returns Int
AS
BEGIN
  Declare
    @CantidadMeses Float,
    @Resultado Int


  Set 
    @CantidadMeses = (Select DateDiff(Month, @FechaInicial, @FechaFinal))
    
If @CantidadMeses > 12
Begin
  Set
    @Resultado = (((@CantidadMeses / 12) - Round(@CantidadMeses / 12, 0, 1)) * 12)
End
Else
Begin
  Set
    @Resultado = @CantidadMeses
End
  
  Return (@Resultado)
END

 (@idProducto varchar(25), @Fecha datetime, @idAlmacen varchar(16), @idUnidad varchar(16))
returns float
as
begin

declare @ExistFisico float,
	@UltimoFisico datetime,
	@ExistMovs float

select 	top 1 
	@ExistFisico = d.Existencia,
	@UltimoFisico = f.Fecha
from Fisico f 
       join FisicoDet d on f.idFisico = d.idFisico
where   
  f.Posteado = 1
  and f.fecha <= @Fecha
  and (f.idAlmacen = @idAlmacen or @idAlmacen is null)
  and d.idProducto = @idProducto 
order by 
  f.Fecha desc

select 
  @ExistMovs = sum(case p.Salida when 1 then -d.Cantidad else d.Cantidad end)
from 
  proMov p 
  join proMovdet d on p.idProMov = d.idProMov
where 
  (p.idAlmacen = @idAlmacen or @idAlmacen is null)
  and p.Fecha between isnull(@UltimoFisico, '01/01/1950') and @Fecha
  and d.idProducto = @idProducto

return isnull(@ExistFisico, 0.00) + isnull(@ExistMovs,0.00)

end

functions.name: ISRCALC
functions.definition:
------------ final de:AFPCALC ------------

------------ inicio de:ISRCALC ------------



CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ISRCALC] (@EmpleadoID int, @NominaID Int) RETURNS Money  
AS    
BEGIN  
-- estas funciones deben verificar si ya hay una transccion modificada y usar esa en lugar de calcular  
DECLARE  
  @Bruto Money,  
  @Hasta Money,  
  @Porciento Float,  
  @APagar Money,  
  @Mes integer,  
  @Ano integer,  
  @Mas Money,  
  @Anterior Money,  
  @UltimaNomina bit,  
  @ISRPorNomina Bit,  
  @CantNominaMes Decimal(19,2),  
  @TotalISRAcumulado Decimal(19,2),  
  @ProyectarISR Bit,  
  @ProyectarSoloSueldo Bit,  
  @TotalSoloSueldo Numeric(18,2),  
  @IdTipoNomina Int,  
  @IdTipoNominaSemanal Int  
  
  if (Select Convert(varchar(16), Valor) From Defaults Where Clave = 'ISR_CATORCENAL') = '1'
    return dbo.nomCalcISRNuevo(@EmpleadoID, @NominaId)
  
  Set @UltimaNomina = (Select ISR FROM Nomina Where NominaID = @NominaID)  
  Set @ISRPorNomina = (Select Convert(Bit, Valor) From Defaults Where Clave = 'ISRPORNOMINA')  
  Set @Apagar = (select top 1 Transaccion from transaccion where TipotransaccionID = 107 and NominaID = @NominaID and EmpleadoID = @EmpleadoID and Modificada = 1)  
  Set @ProyectarISR = IsNull((Select Convert(Bit, Valor) From Defaults Where Clave = 'ProyectarISR'),0)  
  Set @ProyectarSoloSueldo = IsNull((Select Convert(Bit, Valor) From Defaults Where Clave = 'ProySoloSueldo'),0)  
  Set @IdTipoNominaSemanal = IsNull((Select Convert(Int, Valor) From Defaults Where Clave = 'IdNominaSemanal'),0)  
  
  if isnull(@Apagar,-1) = -1  
  begin  
    SET @APagar = 0  
    Select   
      @Ano = Year(N.Fecha),   
      @Mes = N.MesCalendario,  
      @IdTipoNomina = n.TipoNominaId  
    From   
      Nomina N  
    Where   
      N.NominaID = @NominaID  
  
  IF (IsNull(@UltimaNomina,0) = 1) Or (@IdTipoNomina = IsNull(@IdTipoNominaSemanal, 0))-- si esta es la ultima nomina del mes ó el tipo de nomina es semanal  
  Begin  
    Set  
      @CantNominaMes = 1  
    SET @Bruto = (  
                isnull((Select   
   Sum(t.Transaccion)  
  From    Nomina N  
   inner join Transaccion t on n.nominaid = t.nominaid  
   inner join TipoTransaccion tt on t.tipotransaccionid = tt.tipotransaccionid  
  Where     
    tt.debito = 1  
   and tt.TipotransaccionID <> 107  
   and tt.ISRNo = 0  
   AND t.EmpleadoID = @EmpleadoID  
   AND Year(N.fecha) = @Ano  
   AND N.MesCalendario = @Mes),0)  
  -  
         isnull((Select   
   Sum(Transaccion)  
  From    Nomina N  
   inner join Transaccion t on n.nominaid = t.nominaid  
   inner join TipoTransaccion tt on t.tipotransaccionid = tt.tipotransaccionid  
  Where     
    tt.debito = 0  
   and tt.ISRNo = 1  
   and tt.TipotransaccionID <> 107  
   AND t.EmpleadoID = @EmpleadoID  
   AND Year(N.fecha) = @Ano  
   AND N.MesCalendario = @Mes),0)  
 )  
    Set  
      @TotalSoloSueldo = @Bruto  
  End  
  Else  
  begin  
    IF IsNull(@ISRPorNomina,0)=1  
    Begin  
      SET @Bruto = (  
                isnull((Select   
   Sum(t.Transaccion)  
  From    Nomina N  
   inner join Transaccion t on n.nominaid = t.nominaid  
   inner join TipoTransaccion tt on t.tipotransaccionid = tt.tipotransaccionid  
  Where     
    tt.debito = 1  
   and tt.TipotransaccionID <> 107  
   and tt.ISRNo = 0  
   AND t.EmpleadoID = @EmpleadoID  
                        And n.NominaId = @NominaId),0)  
  -  
         isnull((Select   
   Sum(Transaccion)  
  From    Nomina N  
   inner join Transaccion t on n.nominaid = t.nominaid  
   inner join TipoTransaccion tt on t.tipotransaccionid = tt.tipotransaccionid  
  Where     
    tt.debito = 0  
   and tt.ISRNo = 1  
   and tt.TipotransaccionID <> 107  
   AND t.EmpleadoID = @EmpleadoID  
                        And n.NominaId = @NominaId),0))  
      Set  
        @TotalSoloSueldo =   
                isnull((Select   
   Sum(t.Transaccion)  
  From    Nomina N  
   inner join Transaccion t on n.nominaid = t.nominaid  
   inner join TipoTransaccion tt on t.tipotransaccionid = tt.tipotransaccionid  
  Where     
    tt.debito = 1  
   and tt.TipotransaccionID In (100,104)  
   and tt.ISRNo = 0  
   AND t.EmpleadoID = @EmpleadoID  
                        And n.NominaId = @NominaId),0)  
      If @ProyectarISR = 1  
      Begin  
        Set  
          @CantNominaMes =  
                          (SELECT  
                             Anual / 12 As NominaMensual  
                           FROM  
                             TipoNomina tn Inner Join  
                             Nomina     no On (tn.TipoNominaId = no.TipoNominaId)  
                  WHERE  
                              no.NominaId = @NominaId)  
      End  
      Else  
      Begin  
        Set  
          @CantNominaMes = 1  
      End  
      If (@ProyectarSoloSueldo = 1) And (@ProyectarISR = 1) And (@ISRPorNomina = 1)  
      Begin  
        Set  
          @Bruto = @Bruto + (@TotalSoloSueldo * (@CantNominaMes - 1))  
      End  
      Else  
        Set  
          @Bruto = @Bruto * @CantNominaMes  
    End      
End  
---------------------  
    IF (@Bruto > 0) AND ((Select ISR From Empleado Where EmpleadoID = @EmpleadoID) = 1)  
    BEGIN    
      SET @Bruto = (@Bruto * 12)  
      SELECT Top 1  
        @Hasta = Hasta,   
        @Porciento = Porciento,   
        @Mas = Mas  
      FROM   
        ISR  
     WHERE   
       Hasta >= @Bruto  
     ORDER BY   
       Hasta  
      IF @Porciento <> 0   
      BEGIN  
        SELECT Top 1 @Anterior = Hasta  
        FROM ISR  
        WHERE Hasta < @Hasta  
        ORDER BY Hasta Desc   
        SET @APagar = ((@Bruto - @Anterior) * @Porciento) + @Mas  
        SET @APagar = (@APagar / 12)    
      END  
    END  
  end  
IF @UltimaNomina = 1 -- restar el total de isr descontado en el mes   
begin  
  Set @TotalISRAcumulado = isnull((Select Sum(t.Transaccion)  
  From    Nomina N  
   inner join Transaccion t on n.nominaid = t.nominaid  
   --inner join TipoTransaccion tt on t.tipotransaccionid = tt.tipotransaccionid  
  Where     
    t.TipotransaccionID = 107  
   AND t.EmpleadoID = @EmpleadoID  
   AND Year(N.fecha) = @Ano  
   AND t.Nominaid <> @NominaID  
   AND N.MesCalendario = @Mes),0)  
  Set @Apagar = @APagar - @TotalISRAcumulado  
end    
else  
begin  
  Set @Apagar = @Apagar / @CantNominaMes  
end  
RETURN @APagar  
END

functions.name: ISRCALCANUAL

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ISRCALCANUAL](@EmpleadoID int, @Desde datetime, @Hasta Datetime) RETURNS Money
AS  
BEGIN
DECLARE
  @Bruto Money,
  @Porciento Float,
  @APagar Money,
  @Mas Money,
  @Anterior Money,
  @Minimo Money		
  SET @APagar = 0
    SET @Bruto = (
                isnull((Select 
			Sum(t.Transaccion)
		From    Nomina N
			inner join Transaccion t on n.nominaid = t.nominaid
			inner join TipoTransaccion tt on t.tipotransaccionid = tt.tipotransaccionid
		Where   
 			tt.debito = 1
			and tt.TipotransaccionID <> 107
			and tt.ISRNo = 0
			AND t.EmpleadoID = @EmpleadoID
			AND N.fecha between @Desde and @Hasta),0)
		-
	        isnull((Select 
			Sum(Transaccion)
		From    Nomina N
			inner join Transaccion t on n.nominaid = t.nominaid
			inner join TipoTransaccion tt on t.tipotransaccionid = tt.tipotransaccionid
		Where   
 			tt.debito = 0
			and tt.ISRNo = 1
			and tt.TipotransaccionID <> 107
			AND t.EmpleadoID = @EmpleadoID
			AND N.fecha between @Desde and @Hasta),0)
	)
    IF @Bruto > 0
    BEGIN  
      SELECT Top 1
        @Minimo = Hasta, 
        @Porciento = Porciento, 
        @Mas = Mas
      FROM 
        ISR
     WHERE 
       Hasta >= @Bruto
     ORDER BY 
       Hasta
      IF @Porciento <> 0 
      BEGIN
        SELECT Top 1 @Anterior = Hasta
        FROM ISR
        WHERE Hasta < @Minimo
        ORDER BY Hasta Desc
        SET @APagar = ((@Bruto - @Anterior) * @Porciento) + @Mas
      END
    END
  RETURN @APagar
END

create  function [dbo].[lpad] (@instr varchar(8000), @ch char(1), @size int)
returns varchar(8000)
as
begin
declare @str varchar(8000)
declare @len int
set @len = datalength(@instr)
if @len > @size 
  set @str = substring(@instr,1,@size)
else
  set @str = replicate(@ch, @size - datalength(@instr)) + @instr 
return @str --substring(@str,1,@size)
end

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[MontoCotizable] (@EmpleadoID int, @NominaID Int) RETURNS Money
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE
   @Bruto Money
/*
  SET @Bruto = (Select 
			(TotalNormal + TotalNocturna) 
		From 
			NominaEmp 
		Where 
			EmpleadoID = @EmpleadoID and NominaID = @NominaID)
*/
 SET @Bruto = (ISNULL((
		SELECT 
			SUM(Transaccion)

			Join TipoTransaccion TT ON Datos.TipoTransaccionID = TT. TipoTransaccionID

create FUNCTION [dbo].[MontoCotizableMes] (@EmpleadoID int, @NominaID Int) RETURNS Money
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE
   @Bruto Money,

   @Mes integer,
   @Ano integer,
   @IdTipoNomina Int, 
   @hasta datetime,
   @usar_fecha_pago varchar(16)

   Select @usar_fecha_pago = Convert(varchar(16), Valor) 
   From Defaults Where Clave = 'ISR_CATORCENAL'

   if @usar_fecha_pago is null
     set @usar_fecha_pago = '0'

   Select 
      @Ano = Year(N.Fecha), 
      @Mes = N.MesCalendario,
      @IdTipoNomina = n.TipoNominaId,
      @hasta = case @usar_fecha_pago when '1' then n.Fecha else n.Hasta end
    From 
      Nomina N
    Where 
      N.NominaID = @NominaID


 SET @Bruto = (ISNULL((
		SELECT 
			SUM(Transaccion)
		FROM  	
			dbo.Transaccion Datos 
			Join TipoTransaccion TT ON Datos.TipoTransaccionID = TT. TipoTransaccionID
                        Join Nomina n On n.NominaId = Datos.NominaId
		WHERE 	
			(TT.Debito = 1) 
			AND (Datos.Calculada = 0)
			AND (Year(N.fecha) = @Ano)
			AND (N.MesCalendario = @Mes)
			AND (Datos.EmpleadoID = @EmpleadoID)
			AND (TT.Cotizable = 1)
			and case @usar_fecha_pago when '1' then n.fecha else n.hasta end <= @hasta )
		,0))
RETURN @Bruto
END

functions.name: mrhTelefonosPorTipo
functions.definition:
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[mrhTelefonosPorTipo](@IdPersonal Int, @TipoTelefono VarChar(50))
RETURNS VarChar(300) AS
BEGIN 
	Declare
	  @Telefono VarChar(15),
	  @Hold VarChar(300)
	
	Set
	  @Hold = ''
	
	DECLARE
	  cTelefono Cursor 
	For Select
	      Telefono
	    From
	      mrhTelefonos
	    Where
	      IdPersonal = @IdPersonal And
              Descripcion = @TipoTelefono
	  
	Open
	  cTelefono
	
	Fetch Next From cTelefono
	  Into
	    @Telefono
	
	While @@Fetch_Status = 0
	Begin
           If DataLength(@Hold) = 0
           Begin
             Set
               @Hold = @Hold + @Telefono
           End
           Else
           Begin
             Set
               @Hold = @Hold + ' / ' + @Telefono
           End
	
	Fetch Next From cTelefono
	  Into
	    @Telefono
	End
	
	Close
	  cTelefono
	
	Deallocate
	  cTelefono

RETURN 
  @Hold
END

functions.name: nomCalcISRNuevo
functions.definition:
------------ final de:MontoCotizableMes ------------

------------ inicio de:nomCalcISRNuevo ------------

create function [dbo].[nomCalcISRNuevo]
(@idEmpleado int, @idNomina int)
returns decimal(19,2)
as
begin
		
declare @TipoNomina int,
		@cantNominas int,
	    @NominasMes int,
	    @Mes int,
	    @Anno int, 
	    @TotalGanado decimal(19,2),
	    @TotalProyectado decimal(19,2),
	    @TotalISR decimal(19,2),
	    @TotalAFP decimal(19,2),
	    @Sueldo decimal(19,2),
	    @TotalGravado decimal(19,2),
	    @Apagar decimal(19,2),
	    @Fecha datetime 
	    	    
set @Apagar = 0.00	    

select @TipoNomina = TipoNominaID,
	   @Mes = MesCalendario,
	   @Anno = Year(Fecha) ,
	   @Fecha = Fecha 
from nomina n 
where NominaID = @idNomina

select @NominasMes = Cantidad
from nomNominaTipoMes
where TipoNominaId = @TipoNomina and Anno = @Anno and Mes = @Mes


select @CantNominas = count(*)
from nomina
where TipoNominaID = @TipoNomina
	  and Fecha <= @Fecha
	  and MesCalendario = @Mes
	  and Year(Fecha) = @Anno
	  
select @TotalGanado = sum(t.Transaccion)
from Nomina n join Transaccion t on n.NominaID = t.NominaID
  join TipoTransaccion tt on t.TipoTransaccionID = tt.TipoTransaccionID 
where n.MesCalendario = @Mes 
      and Year(Fecha) = @Anno 
      and t.EmpleadoID = @idEmpleado
      and n.TipoNominaId = @TipoNomina 
      and tt.Debito = 1
      and tt.ISRNo = 0
      and t.TipoTransaccionID <> 107 -- ISR
      and n.Fecha <= @Fecha 
      
select @TotalAFP = sum(t.Transaccion)
from Nomina n join Transaccion t on n.NominaID = t.NominaID
  join TipoTransaccion tt on t.TipoTransaccionID = tt.TipoTransaccionID 
where n.MesCalendario = @Mes 
      and Year(Fecha) = @Anno 
      and t.EmpleadoID = @idEmpleado
      and n.TipoNominaId = @TipoNomina 
      and tt.Debito = 0
      and tt.ISRNo = 1
      and t.TipoTransaccionID <> 107 -- ISR
      and n.Fecha <= @Fecha
      
select @TotalISR = sum(t.Transaccion)
from Nomina n join Transaccion t on n.NominaID = t.NominaID
  join TipoTransaccion tt on t.TipoTransaccionID = tt.TipoTransaccionID 
where n.MesCalendario = @Mes 
      and Year(Fecha) = @Anno 
      and t.EmpleadoID = @idEmpleado
      and n.TipoNominaId = @TipoNomina       
      and t.TipoTransaccionID = 107 -- ISR
      and n.Fecha <= @Fecha      
      and n.NominaID <> @idNomina 
      
select @Sueldo = (SueldoMes * 12.00) / 26.00
from Empleado
where EmpleadoID = @idEmpleado 

select @TotalProyectado = @Sueldo * (@NominasMes - @CantNominas)

select @TotalGravado = (isnull(@TotalGanado,0.00) - isnull(@TotalAFP,0.00) + isnull(@TotalProyectado,0.00)) * 12

declare @hasta decimal(19,2),
		@porciento float,
		@Mas decimal(19,2),
		@anterior decimal(19,2) 

select top 1 
		@Hasta = Hasta,   
        @Porciento = Porciento,   
        @Mas = Mas  
from ISR  
where Hasta >= @TotalGravado
order by Hasta  
      
if @Porciento <> 0 begin
  select top 1 @Anterior = Hasta  
  from ISR  
  where Hasta < @Hasta  
  order by Hasta desc   
  
  set @APagar = (((@TotalGravado - @Anterior) * @Porciento) + @Mas) / 12.00
  set @APagar = @Apagar - isnull(@TotalISR,0.00)
end
    
--select @TotalGanado as Ganado, 
--       @TotalProyectado as Proyectado, 
--       @TotalAFP as AFP_ARS, 
--       @NominasMes as NominasMes, 
--       @CantNominas as CantNominas, 
--       @TotalISR as TotalISR, 
--       @Apagar as ISR,
--       @Apagar / ((@NominasMes - @CantNominas) + 1) as ISR_X_Nomina

return isnull(@Apagar / ((@NominasMes - @CantNominas) + 1),0.00)
end

create function [dbo].[nomCalcProvisionBonos](@Valor decimal(19,2), @EmpId int, @Fec datetime)  
returns decimal(19,2)  
as  
BEGIN  
  declare @ret decimal(19,2)  
  
  select @ret = Round(((@Valor / 11.915) * (case when datediff(month, e.Inicio, @fec) < 36 then 45 else 60 end))/24,2)  
  from empleado e  
  where e.empleadoid = @Empid    
    
  return isnull(@ret,0.00)  
end

As
SELECT 
 *
